list.text: North to Lavender Town\nWest to Fuchsia City
Why is it I always get the urge to whistle when walking through nature?
Instead of communicating with Pokemon with words, you can communicate with time through whistling!
I should go to Rock Tunnel to get myself an Onix.
I see... Well, that's fine by me.\nI've always got my mountain!
My weight puts me in the featherweight class!
...Huh? What do you mean that doesn't sound very strong?
It was fun battling you!
I need some time to rest.\nLet's battle!
Training Pokemon is tiring.
A Pokemon Battle?\nCool!\nLet's go!
You knew you were going to win.\nThat's why you challenged me.
We run because of the large open spaces.
Don't rush, and take the road one step at a time. Great advice!
My dream is to fly with my beloved bird Pokemon.
You have Pokemon that know the HM move Fly, don't you? I envy you.

then.text: Jan: Do you want to battle?\nYou don't have enough Pokemon for that...

list.text: Jan: Kiri, let's go!\nWe have to try!
Jan: Kiri, don't cry!\nWe're gonna win on the next one!

then.text: Kiri: Do you want to battle?\nYou don't have enough Pokemon for that...

list.text: Kiri: Jan, let's try really hard!
Kiri: We lost because of me?
I caught a bit of the news and they were talking about Kanto again.
It seems things got quite messy over there, don't you agree?
Anyway...\nI’m going to be in Saffron for work.
If you’re nearby, you can meet me at the station for a minute.
I’ve got something for you.\nJust a small thing.
...No rush. If you can’t make it, it’s fine.
I need to go, bye!
